edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Ownable constructor.
now is written to startTime in the AxtrustICO constructor.
now is written to endTime when the ICO is stopped or hard cap reached.
Result of createTokenContract is stored in the token state variable.
The token contract instance is the target of the external mint call.
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient in buyTokens.
buyTokens reads msg.sender to mint tokens to the purchaser.
tokensMinted is read and compared against the hard cap in buyTokens.
minimumSupply is used to enforce the minimum purchase in buyTokens.
HARD_CAP_TOKENS bounds total minted amount in buyTokens.
rate is used to compute the token amount in buyTokens.
isFinished guards the buyTokens purchase path.
weiRaised is incremented with the purchase value in buyTokens.
owner is the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
owner is compared against msg.sender by the onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner gates stopICO using msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates setRate using msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates issueTokens using msg.sender.
setRate parameter _rate is written into the rate state variable.
issueTokens parameter _to is used as mint recipient.
Local amount is derived from the _amount parameter.
_amount * 10**18 is an unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
The scaled amount local variable is passed to the token mint call.
weiAmount is used together with rate to compute tokens.
weiAmount is added into weiRaised in buyTokens.
Computed tokens amount is minted to the purchaser.
Computed tokens amount is added to tokensMinted.
The payable fallback function forwards incoming ether to buyTokens.
buyTokens performs an external ETH transfer to owner while ICO state is only partially finalized.
buyTokens makes an external call to token.mint before completing all state updates.
issueTokens makes an external call to token.mint before finalizing state.
The AxtrustICO constructor calls createTokenContract to deploy the token.
The Ownable constructor initializes the owner state variable.
mint increases totalSupply using SafeMath.add.
mint increases the recipient balance using SafeMath.add.
transfer mutates balances using SafeMath sub/add.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping using SafeMath.sub.
increaseApproval adds to the allowed mapping using SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor _rate parameter only exists to initialize the rate state variable.
The setRate _rate parameter is only used to update the rate state variable.
The _to parameter is only consumed by the issueTokens mint call.
The _amount parameter flows into the external token.mint call, so it can be merged into that unsafe operation.
The scaled amount local is only used to feed the external token.mint call.
weiAmount is a temporary derived from msg.value used only inside buyTokens.
The tokens local is only used to pass the amount to the external token.mint and update tokensMinted.
